'''Agatanushi Jinja''' (県主神社 or 縣主神社) is a [[Shinto shrine]] in Japan.
* [[Agatanushi Shrine (Minokamo)]] - Located in [[Minokamo, Gifu]], Gifu Prefecture.
* [[Agatanushi Shrine (Ibara)]] - Located in [[Ibara, Okayama]], Okayama Prefecture.
